label: Paired positive conditional corroboration criterion
paraphrase: For every positive rational four-cell report table under each of two exhaustive hypotheses and non-dogmatic prior, joint posterior strictly exceeds the B posterior iff P(A|B,H)>P(A|B,notH), equivalently P(A|B,H)>P(A|B). Joint posterior strictly exceeds both marginals iff this criterion and its label-swapped counterpart both hold. The joint Bayes factor equals the B factor times the conditional A-given-B likelihood ratio. Analyst arithmetic, not calibrated witness reliability or categorical warrant; see docs/notes/correlated-testimony-1396.md.
